fields.label: Turn the snippet on
fields.description: Enable the "ambxst" snippet in each vault the first time it is written. If you turn it off in Obsidian later, it stays off.

fields.label: Match dark/light
fields.description: Switch Obsidian's base theme to dark or light with the Ambxst palette.

fields.label: Obsidian vaults
fields.description: Leave empty to use every vault Obsidian knows. Otherwise, vault folders separated by commas, e.g. ~/Documents/Notes.
